messages:
maria gonzalez: Quick sanity check — proposing a schema change for console telemetry. We want to: 1) consolidate per-route metric indices into a single `route_attr_index` (less joins), and 2) add an append-only audit_log table for route attribution events. Main question: how do we keep dashboard p99s stable during the canary/backfill? /cc @sasha r @david nguyen :eyes:

david nguyen: Love the consolidation idea. Two concerns: dualwrite complexity vs read-adapter. My leaning: shadow dualwrite + read-adapter that materializes a compact MV for the console. That lets us validate correctness before cutover.

sasha r: Index bloat is my worry. If we merge indices, cardinality explosion (route attrs + tenant) will kill writes. Need hashed route keys + weekly partitioning. Also limit indexed attributes to a small canonical set.

john lee: For the p99 question — we should gate with query-SLO monitors during canary and have an automatic fallback route that points dashboards to the old index if p99 > 250ms for 5m.

infra-bot: Canary environment `console-telemetry-canary-3` provisioned (k8s namespace created, pg replica attached). See: https://ci.internal/redwood/canaries/3321001234 :white_check_mark:

maria gonzalez: Example minimal schema I'm thinking (pseudocode):
```sql
create table route_attr_index (
  route_hash bigint not null,
  tenant_id uuid not null,
  metric_name text not null,
  value double precision,
  ts timestamptz not null,
  primary key (route_hash, ts)
) partition by range (ts);

create table route_attr_audit (
  id uuid primary key,
  route_hash bigint,
  change jsonb,
  recorded_at timestamptz default now()
);
```
Backfill plan: staged weekly windows, write-to-shadow then replay to MV.

david nguyen: Shadow dualwrite sketch: send 100% write to old + shadow topic, but only apply 10% of shadow to MV during dry-run. Use `kafka-shadow-producer --topic telemetry-shadow --sample-rate=0.1`. If results close, ramp.

sasha r: Dashboard fallback idea: precompute last-24h aggregates into Redis (TTL 5m) and route GraphQL queries to cache first. That reduces pressure on new MV while backfill runs. Also need a compact serialization for route_attr to keep cache small.

john lee: Rollback/playbook notes: 1) disable canary writes to MV; 2) flip dashboards to pre-agg cache; 3) stop backfill jobs; 4) revert schema DDL in a transactional-friendly way. We should script all 4.

maria gonzalez: Action items I can take: create a perf sim job (queries against local MV snapshot), set up shadow dualwrite runner, and draft rollback scripts. Meeting to align tomorrow 10am. Anyone object? :+1:

david nguyen: +1. I'll own the shadow producer config and sampling dashboard.

sasha r: +1. I'll prototype weekly partitioning + route_hash function and run cardinality estimates.

john lee: +1. I'll author the SLO monitors and the dashboard flip playbook.

maria gonzalez: Cool — I'll post the canary checklist and link the backfill dry-run results in this thread once ready. Thanks all. :rocket:
